subject: Quantacre technical deep-dive & inference topology review
messages:
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
To: Tom Reynolds <tom@quantacre.ai>, Sara Li <sara.li@quantacre.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 03 Sep 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Quantacre technical deep-dive & inference topology review

Hi Tom / Sara —

Thanks again for the discovery session yesterday. We heard that Quantacre wants to validate latency and scaling behavior across a few deployment shapes (hosted, dedicated, and an optional VPC/private flow). To make the deep-dive productive, can we lock a 75-minute timebox next week for a technical walkthrough and Q&A? Suggested agenda: 1) goals & workload profile (10m) 2) model & sequence characteristics (10m) 3) serving topology options (30m) 4) integration & security considerations (15m) 5) next steps & action items (10m).

Proposed windows (PDT):
- Tues 9/8, 10:00–11:15
- Wed 9/9, 08:00–09:15 (if you need an earlier start)
- Thu 9/10, 13:00–14:15

Attendees from our side: Ben Carter (Pre-sales engineer), Marissa Cole (Customer Success). If you want us to invite any runtime engineers or networking/security SMEs, say the word and we’ll add them.

I attached a short mutual-action-plan (Quantacre-MAP.pdf) with the proposed agenda and a brief pre-call checklist. Please let me know which window works and whether you want a physical calendar invite with a shared agenda doc.

Thanks —
Olga
Olga Petrov | Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
Attachments: Quantacre-MAP.pdf
From: Tom Reynolds <tom@quantacre.ai>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
Cc: Sara Li <sara.li@quantacre.ai>, procurement@quantacre.ai
Date: Thu, 03 Sep 2026 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quantacre technical deep-dive & inference topology review

Hi Olga —

Appreciate the quick follow-up. The team is keen, but our CTO has a narrow window and prefers GTM-aligned attendees earlier in the day. Can we do Tue 9/8 at 08:00–09:15 PDT instead? That would let our execs join for the first 20 minutes. If that’s not possible, Wed 9/9 at 08:00 works too.

Also, we’d like the session to touch on: 1) expected token throughput for 1k QPS across mixed seq lengths, 2) KV cache warmup/rollover behavior during bursts, and 3) any constraints when using encrypted/model artifacts in a VPC deployment.

I’ll drop the procurement team on copy — they may have a short list of compliance questions ahead of the call.

Thanks,
Tom
Tom Reynolds | Head of Platform Engineering
Quantacre
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Tom Reynolds <tom@quantacre.ai>, Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 04 Sep 2026 08:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quantacre technical deep-dive & inference topology review

Tom —

08:00–09:15 PDT on Tue 9/8 could work from our side; I’m happy to take the 30–40 minute topology deep-dive. A couple quick asks so we can tailor the session:
- Can you share a rough distribution of sequence lengths (median, 90th percentile) and whether you have frequent multi-turn contexts that rely on long KV caches?
- Will you be bringing a custom model (private weights) or using an open model we catalog — this impacts the quantization/compilation options we'll show.

We’ll bring: a short topology diagram (redwood-topology-v2.png) showing hosted vs dedicated vs VPC routing, example latency numbers for mixed-length workloads, and a checklist for artifact encryption & KMS integration. If you prefer, I can run a tiny synthetic microbenchmark during the call to show warmup effects (would need 5–10 minutes and a sandbox token).

Also — slight calendar note: our dashboard is in PDT; if any of your team are in CET/UTC let me know so we add calendar times.

—Ben
Ben Carter | Senior Pre-Sales Engineer
Redwood Inference
Attachments: redwood-topology-v2.png
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
To: Tom Reynolds <tom@quantacre.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, procurement@quantacre.ai
Date: Tue, 07 Sep 2026 14:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quantacre technical deep-dive & inference topology review

Tom —

Thanks — Tue 9/8 08:00–09:15 PDT is good for us; I’ve penciled it in on our side. Ben will lead the topology/benchmarks portion and Marissa will run through onboarding/next steps toward a pilot.

To help focus the technical portion, can you complete the short tech questionnaire before the call? It’s a 6-question form (model types, typical token lengths, SSO/KMS needs, VPC requirements, data residency, and estimated QPS). Link here: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2b3C4d5E (we’ll pull answers into the session). If you prefer to send a quick doc instead, that’s fine.

We’ll send a calendar invite and an agenda doc by EOD.

Best,
Olga
From: Tom Reynolds <tom@quantacre.ai>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
Cc: Sara Li <sara.li@quantacre.ai>, procurement@quantacre.ai, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 08 Sep 2026 11:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quantacre technical deep-dive & inference topology review

Olga / team —

Confirmed: Tue 9/8, 08:00–09:15 PDT. I’ve attached our quick answers (quantacre-tech-answers.docx). For attendees: our CTO (Ellen Park) will join the first 20 minutes, myself, and Sara (platform lead). Procurement will join if we move into specifics.

One ask for the calendar invite — could you add the UTC/CET equivalents in the description? Ellen will be in CET that week. Also please drop any pre-reads (short topology notes or benchmark snippets) into the invite so execs can scan before the call.

Thanks — looking forward to it.
Tom
Attachments: quantacre-tech-answers.docx
